description:
DashThis is an automated marketing reporting tool that uses AI to collect, visualize, and deliver insights from analytics, SEO, PPC, and social data. It simplifies cross-channel reporting for marketers.

DashThis automates marketing reports for agencies and teams. Connect 30+ tools into client-ready dashboards in minutes. Try free for 14 days.

Automated dashboards from all your data sources. Custom and prebuilt templates for fast setup. Collaboration tools for sharing and commenting. AI-powered insights highlight key changes.

howToUse.title: Sign Up & Connect Data Sources
howToUse.description: Register on DashThis and log in. Connect your analytics, SEO, PPC, and social accounts for unified reporting.

howToUse.title: Create or Select a Dashboard Template
howToUse.description: Pick from prebuilt templates or customize your own dashboard to suit your reporting needs.

howToUse.title: Automate Data Collection
howToUse.description: Let DashThis automatically fetch and update your data across all connected platforms.

howToUse.title: Collaborate and Share
howToUse.description: Invite team members to comment and collaborate on reports, or share dashboards with stakeholders.

howToUse.title: Leverage AI Insights
howToUse.description: Use AI-powered suggestions and visualizations to spot key trends, anomalies, and growth opportunities.
